description: Smoketest is an AI browser testing service for web application smoke tests such as signup, login, and checkout. It runs tests in a real browser and returns recordings, step logs, and pass/fail results, with both reusable tests and issue-driven QA workflows.
summary: Smoketest exposes a REST API at `api.smoketest.sh/v1`, a remote MCP server at `api.smoketest.sh/mcp`, and an npm-distributed `smoketest` CLI; all require authentication via Smoketest-issued credentials.
